description: This file contains a custom assertion class 'ThingQueryCommandResponseAssert' for testing 'ThingQueryCommandResponse' objects, extending an abstract assertion class and providing methods to verify various properties of the response such as type, headers, resource path, status, and entity.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandResponseAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for 'ThingQueryCommandResponse' objects, providing fluent methods to verify response properties in tests.

methods.name: ThingQueryCommandResponseAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion with the actual response object.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected type.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected Ditto headers.

methods.name: withResourcePath
methods.description: Overloaded methods to verify the resource path of the response, either by string and segments or by JsonPointer.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected HTTP status code.

methods.name: withEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected JSON entity.
